jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Was du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey IT Solutions AG erbringt für die Emil Frey Gruppe verschiedene, zentrale ICT-Dienstleistungen und verwaltet die Server-Backend Systeme in zwei Datacenters zusammen mit der Hybrid-Cloud Infrastruktur für ca. 10'000 User, welche an über 100 Standorten in Europa arbeiten. Für die IT-Infrastructure-Abteilung am Standort Zürich-Altstetten oder Safenwil, suchen wir eine/n Network Security Engineer Welche Aufgaben wirst du übernehmen
• Sicherstellung des stabilen und sicheren Betriebs der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum
• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur
• Bearbeitung von Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support
• Erstellung technischer Konzepte, Systemübersichten sowie umfassender Dokumentationen
• Planung und Durchführen von Umstellungen und Systemwartungen Was du mitbringst
• Fachausbildung in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewall und Security-Plattformen, vorzugsweise von Fortinet
• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) sind von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python sind von Vorteil
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst Was dich bei uns erwartet Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie du uns kontaktieren kannst Wir freuend uns auf deine vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.
• Sicherstellung des stabilen und sicheren Betriebs der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum
• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur
• Bearbeitung von Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support
• Erstellung technischer Konzepte, Systemübersichten sowie umfassender Dokumentationen
• Planung und Durchführen von Umstellungen und Systemwartungen
• Fachausbildung in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewall und Security-Plattformen, vorzugsweise von Fortinet
• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) sind von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python sind von Vorteil
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst

descriptionByLocale.it:
Quello che dovresti sapere su di noi Il Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda svizzera a conduzione familiare con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e attenzione al cliente sono i pilastri portanti dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marchi automobilistici, sulla gestione di garage, sulla logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e sulla fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG fornisce vari servizi ICT centralizzati per il gruppo Emil Frey e gestisce i sistemi di back-end del server in due data center insieme all'infrastruttura cloud ibrida per circa 10.000 utenti che lavorano in oltre 100 sedi in Europa. Per il reparto IT Infrastructure nella sede di Zurigo-Altstetten o Safenwil, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Network Security Engineer Quali compiti svolgerai
• Garantire il funzionamento stabile e sicuro dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall nel data center
• Continuo sviluppo dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall
• Gestione dei guasti nel supporto di 2° e 3° livello
• Creazione di concetti tecnici, panoramiche del sistema e documentazione completa
• Pianificazione ed esecuzione di conversioni e manutenzione del sistema Cosa porti
• Formazione specialistica in informatica o qualifica comparabile
• Esperienza pluriennale nel funzionamento di firewall e piattaforme di sicurezza,
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approx. 10,000 users working at over 100 locations in Europe. For the IT infrastructure department at the Zurich-Altstetten or Safenwil location, we are looking for a Network Security Engineer What tasks will you take on
• Ensuring the stable and secure operation of the central firewall infrastructure in the data center
• Continuous further development of the central firewall infrastructure
• Processing of disruptions in 2nd and 3rd level support
• Creation of technical concepts, system overviews and comprehensive documentation
• Planning and implementation of conversions and system maintenance What you bring with you
• Specialist training in computer science or comparable qualifications
• Several years of experience in the operation of firewall and security platforms,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Questo è il Gruppo Emil Frey, una famiglia svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza e uno dei principali protagonisti dell'industria automobilistica. - I Pilastri dell'azienda sono qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente. - L'attività è concentrata sull'importazione di case automobilistiche, sulla gestione delle officine, sulla logistica dei pezzi di ricambio e degli accessori, senza la fornitura di servizi finanziari. - La Emil Frey AG San Gallo è partner ufficiale di vendita e assistenza per i prodotti Jaguar, Land Rover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru e Zeekr, con carrozzeria e rivista di pezzi del Rizambico. Mansioni - Esecuzione di lavori di servizio e riparazione in base a tutte le indicazioni del produttore. - Verifica della funzionalità dei vari componenti. - Diagnosi con l'aiuto del capo officina. - Partecipazione regolare a corsi e formazione specifica per il marchio.
• Requisiti - Abilitazione professionale completata come Automotive Mechatronics Technician EFZ. - Formazione o interesse per la formazione come diagnostico automobilistico, un vantaggio. - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, di lavorare in squadra e di avere un senso della qualità. - Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca, sia orale che scritta. - Brevetti nella Guida categoria B.
• Cosa offriamo - Un'opportunità di lavoro stimolante con compiti interessanti e molto altro. - Numerose agevolazioni (nuovo e usato, lavori di servicio e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazioni car e sanitarie, carte benzina, hotel e molto altro). - A proprio fondo pensionistico attraente come istituzione previdenziale indipendente. - Una prospettiva aziendale un lungo appuntamento. - Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuale. - Almeno 25 giorni di ferie. Contatta Daniela Bühler, Responsabile Regionale, in attesa di una candidatura completa (come curriculum, certificato di lavoro, ecc.) tramite il link "Candidati ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si rinuncia all'uso contemporaneo delle forme linguistiche macchina, femminili e diverse (m/f/d). Sono espressamente comprese anche le donne e le altre identità del genere. La diversità per noi significanta anche le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, arrivano e migliori risultati possibili. Siamo convinti che una forza lavoro diversificata e una cultura inclusiva ci consentano di sfruttare al massimo il nostro potenziale. Mansioni (ripetute) - Esecuzione di lavori di servicio e riparazione in base a tutte le indicazioni del produttore. - Verifica della funzionalità dei vari componenti. - Diagnosi con l'aiuto del capo officina. - Partecipazione regolare a corsi e formazione specifica per il marchio.
• Requisiti (ripetuti) - Abilitazione professionale completata come Automotive Mechatronics Engineer EFZ. - Formazione o interesse per la formazione come diagnostico automobilistico, un vantaggio. - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, di lavorare in squadra e di avere un senso della qualità. - Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca, sia orale che scritta. - Brevetti nella categoria guida B.

Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the company's pillars. The activities focus on importing automotive brands, operating garages, logistics for spare parts and accessories, as well as providing financial services. The Bern Autocenter of Emil Frey AG represents 12 global brands under one roof. Tasks - Competent consulting and assistance to our customers in purchasing vehicles - Sale of new and used Land Rover vehicles, including additional services (financing, leasing, insurance) - Building and maintaining long-term relationships with customers - Active acquisition of new customers (showroom, phone, online requests) - Creating offers and managing purchase contracts - Organizing and conducting test drives - Maintaining and presenting the vehicle fleet in the showroom - Participating in brand-specific courses and training
• Requirements - Experience in the automotive sector and sales of new vehicles - Passion for automobiles and pleasure in customer contact - Convincing behavior and negotiation skills - Independent, result-oriented, and structured work - High customer and service orientation - Good IT knowledge - Category B driver's license
• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - An attractive pension scheme as an independent pension fund - A long-term perspective for the company - Opportunities for individual training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Klaudia Dushaj, HR employee, will be pleased to receive your complete job application (e.g., resume, work certificates, etc.) via the "Apply now!" link. For readability reasons, we have decided not to use masculine, feminine, and diverse grammatical forms (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to exploit our potential to the fullest.

La Emil Frey Gruppe non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. La Emil Frey AG Altendorf è il partner ufficiale di vendita e assistenza per le marche Mercedes-Benz, Opel e Suzuki e dispone di una carrozzeria e un magazzino di parti di ricambio. Mansioni - Eseguire lavori di diagnosi, riparazione e manutenzione - Analizzare e risolvere problemi tecnici ed elettronici con l'ausilio di sistemi di diagnosi moderni - Assicurare l'osservanza di standard di qualità e sicurezza, nonché supportare il capo della officina - Partecipare regolarmente a corsi di formazione e aggiornamento specifici per le marche
• Requisiti - Laurea di scuola professionale in meccatronica automobilistica EFZ con specializzazione in diagnostica automobilistica o in formazione per il ruolo di diagnostico automobilistico, MB Systemtechniker - Esperienza consolidata nel settore della diagnosi automobilistica - Abilità analitica, strutturata e orientata al risultato - Elevato senso di responsabilità, affidabilità, impegno e determinazione - Disponibilità a partecipare a corsi di formazione interessanti per rimanere aggiornato sulla tecnologia più recente - Orientamento al cliente, atteggiamento positivo e possesso di un valido patentino di guida di categoria B
• Cosa offriamo - Numerose agevolazioni (auto nuove e usate, lavori di servizio e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattia, carte di credito per carburante, alberghi e molto altro) - Una pensione di vecchiaia attraente come ente di previdenza indipendente - Una prospettiva di lungo termine per l'azienda - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo individualizzate - Minimo 25 giorni di ferie Contatto Vanessa Aminger, Responsabile regionale per il personale, si compiace della completa presentazione della candidatura (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) tramite il link "Candidato ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschili, femminili e diverse (m/w/d). Le identità di genere femminili e altre sono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa per noi che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i migliori risultati possibili. Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro diversificata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive sector. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Activities focus on the importation of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Altendorf is the official sales and support partner for the Mercedes-Benz, Opel, and Suzuki brands and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse.
• Responsibilities - Perform diagnostic, repair, and maintenance work - Analyze and resolve technical and electronic problems with the aid of modern diagnostic systems - Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards, as well as support the workshop manager - Regularly participate in specific training and updating courses for the brands
• Requirements - Professional degree in automotive mechatronics EFZ with specialization in automotive diagnostics or training for the role of automotive diagnostician, MB Systemtechnician - Consolidated experience in the field of automotive diagnostics - Analytical, structured, and result-oriented skills - High sense of responsibility, reliability, commitment, and determination - Availability to participate in interesting training courses to stay up-to-date with the latest technology - Customer-oriented, positive attitude, and valid category B driving license
• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - Attractive old-age pension as an independent pension fund - Long-term perspective for the company - Individualized opportunities for training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Vanessa Aminger, Regional Personnel Manager, welcomes the complete submission of the application (e.g., curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Candidate now!". For readability reasons, it has been decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse and integrated team and a culture of integration enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an engaged, sales-strong, and entrepreneurially thinking person as Key Account Manager/-in Automotive ZH-Ost. In this role, you will be responsible for the two Emil Frey branches in Volketswil and Winterthur and drive the active acquisition of new customers in the corporate and fleet customer business in particular. In this way, you will represent an attractive portfolio of 11 world brands in the passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors, creating ideal conditions for sustainable sales success. Your tasks
• Active customer acquisition with a clear focus on corporate and fleet customers in the sales area
• Building and maintaining a strong network of corporate customers
• Development and implementation of targeted sales and acquisition strategies
• Consulting customers on comprehensive mobility solutions (including TCO, electrification, and fleet optimization)
• Promoting and expanding cooperation with leasing providers and partners in the fleet management sector
• Close cooperation with manufacturers and internal interfaces
• Market observation and identification of new business opportunities
• At least three years of experience as a Key Account Manager in the automotive sector with a focus on corporate and fleet customers
• Verifiable sales success in customer acquisition and business development
• In-depth knowledge in the field of fleet management, leasing, and mobility solutions
• Strong hunter mentality paired with sustainable relationship management and high closing skills
• Entrepreneurial thinking and structured working style
• High personal motivation, resilience, and impact
• German (mother tongue), English (very good knowledge), French (an advantage)
• Category B driving license

• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, maintenance and repair work, spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels and more) - An attractive old-age pension as an independent pension fund - A long-term career perspective - Possibility of individual training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, will be pleased to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The Emil Frey AG, Züri-Oberland Volketswil is the official sales and service partner of the exclusive brands BMW and MINI and creates fascination and joy of driving. Your tasks

• You develop for your customers suitable financing and insurance solutions
• You create offers as well as attractive exchange and leasing offers
• You carry out an active acquisition of new customers
• You process incoming leads professionally, competently and promptly
• You take care of the showroom Your profile
• Completed commercial vocational training or a comparable qualification
• Several years of experience as a sales advisor in the automotive industry
• Customer contact is your passion and you have a developed sales flair
• You convince through a sovereign and cultivated appearance
• Flexibility, resilience, empathy and a future-oriented way of thinking are among your central strengths
• You share our enthusiasm for the automotive industry and bring passion for the MINI brand
• A structured and precise way of working, negotiation security as well as a developed customer orientation complete your profile
• Stylish German in word and writing, further foreign languages are an advantage
• Category B driving license What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual further education and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday How to contact us Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG, Winterthur, is the official sales and service partner of the brands Toyota, Kia, Opel, Suzuki, Lepamotor, Mitsubishi, Subaru, Jaguar, and Land Rover and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse. Your responsibilities
• Successfully sell new and used vehicles
• Provide comprehensive customer care from the first contact to the delivery of the vehicle, including competent advice on model selection, as well as financing and insurance solutions
• Ensure professional after-sales care with the goal of long-term customer satisfaction
• Care and continuous development of the existing customer base, as well as active acquisition of new customers
• Participate in events and exhibitions Your profile
• Completed education, preferably in the automotive industry, with a commercial education or a commercial basic education
• Customer and service-oriented personality with strong communication skills, as well as a confident and convincing appearance
• You share our passion for the automotive industry and have the necessary technical knowledge
• Secure written and spoken German, other foreign languages are an advantage
• Category B driving license What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Dominik Egli, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the forms of address masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, through their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devriez savoir sur nous. Le Groupe Emil Frey n'est pas seulement une entreprise familiale suisse avec 100 ans d'expérience, mais également l'une des principales entreprises de l'industrie automobile. Qualité, tradition, innovation et orientation client sont les piliers de l'entreprise. Les activités sont axées sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. L'Emil Frey AG de Volketswil est le partenaire de vente et de service officiel des marques Mercedes Benz, Kia, Opel, Mazda et Suzuki et dispose également d'une carrosserie et d'un entrepôt de pièces de rechange. Vos responsabilités
• Vente réussie : vous êtes responsable de la vente de véhicules neufs et d'occasion de la marque innovante KIA
• Conseil au client : vous offrez un conseil orienté client, complet et professionnel, et vous assurez une prise en charge constante et professionnelle des clients existants et nouveaux
• Service complet : vous créez des offres personnalisées, des estimations de change, des offres de location et d'assurance
• Gestion des relations : vous maintenez activement notre clientèle existante et gagnez de nouveaux clients avec enthousiasme
• Présence au point de vente : vous assurez notre accessibilité et effectuez des services le samedi au showroom
• Événements : vous travaillez activement sur les expositions et les événements des clients
• Expérience de vente : vous apportez au moins deux ou trois ans d'expérience de vente réussie, préférablement dans l'industrie automobile ou le secteur des services
• Passion pour l'automobile : vous avez une grande passion pour l'industrie automobile et êtes enthousiasmé par la vente d'automobiles
• Personnalité gagnante : le contact avec le client est votre force absolue. Vous convainquez avec un comportement sûr et raffiné, ainsi qu'avec un fort flair de vente
• Mentalité de service : une forte orientation client, un haut idée de service et des compétences de négociation sont vos caractéristiques
• Flexibilité : vous êtes résilient, prêt à apprendre et apportez la volonté de travailler le samedi
• Compétence linguistique : vous vous exprimez avec confiance en allemand et avez de bonnes connaissances en anglais. D'autres langues étrangères comme le français ou l'italien sont un grand avantage
• Volonté de réussite : vous avez un vrai mindset de gagnant avec un focus sur l'atteinte des objectifs et une grande initiative personnelle
• Mobilité : vous avez un permis de conduire valide de catégorie B Ce que nous offrons à vous. Vous trouverez avec nous une nouvelle challenge avec des tâches excitantes et beaucoup d'autres choses encore :
• De nombreuses avantages (véhicules neufs et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces de rechange, assurance, cartes de carburant, hôtels et beaucoup d'autres choses)
• Une pension attractive comme une caisse de pension indépendante
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Des opportunités individuelles de formation et de développement
• Au moins 25 jours de vacances Comment vous pouvez nous contacter. Chiara Staccioli, responsable régionale du personnel, se réjouit de votre demande de candidature complète (par exemple, curriculum vitae, attestations de travail, etc.) via le lien "Candidater maintenant !" Pour une meilleure lisibilité, nous avons décidé de ne pas utiliser simultanément les formes grammaticales masculines, féminines et diverses (m/w/d). Les femmes et les autres identités de genre sont explicitement incluses. La diversité signifie pour nous que les personnes travaillent dans des équipes qui, en raison de leur unicité et de leur diversité, atteignent les meilleurs résultats. Nous sommes convaincus que des équipes diversifiées et une culture intégrative nous permettent d'exploiter notre plein potentiel.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Carrosseriewerk Safenwil of Emil Frey AG has made a name for itself nationwide for its special car body constructions. It manufactures custom-built bridge and trailer constructions, vehicles for disabled people, as well as workshop, office, or laboratory vehicles. Your tasks
• Assembly of various body groups in the automotive industry (soldering, riveting, gluing)
• Provision of vehicles
• MFK inspections (Category B certificate) Your profile
• Skilled in manual work
• Several years of experience as a mechanic or experience in a production company
• Efficient and meticulous working methods
• Diligent, reliable
• Mother tongue German or very good oral German skills What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday
• Free parking
• Personal restaurant How to contact us For reasons of readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential. jobs.description:
Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur lebt von gegenseitigem Vertrauen, Nähe zu den Menschen und echter Zusammenarbeit über alle Ebenen hinweg. Wir sind überzeugt, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg dort entsteht, wo Menschen sich gehört, unterstützt und weiterentwickelt fühlen. Genau hier setzt unsere HR‑Arbeit an: nah an den Standorten, im direkten Austausch mit Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden und mit dem Anspruch, aktiv zu gestalten. Dafür suchen wir Dich – eine HR‑Persönlichkeit mit Herz, Kompetenz und dem Willen, wirklich etwas zu bewirken. Deine Aufgaben – vielseitig & nah an den Menschen
• Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende an mehreren Standorten und begleitest sämtliche HR‑Themen von der Gewinnung bis zum Austritt
• Du übernimmst die selbstständige Rekrutierung von Fach- und Führungskräften und begleitest den gesamten Auswahlprozess
• Du wirkst aktiv bei Veränderungsprozessen mit und begleitest diese professionell und lösungsorientiert
• Du verantwortest die gesamte HR‑Administration entlang des Employee Lifecycles
• Du berätst und unterstützt die Linienvorgesetzten bei den jährlichen, zentralen HR‑Prozessen Dein Profil – fachlich kompetent & menschlich überzeugend
• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Human Resources Management (mind. eidg. Fachausweis)
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in vergleichbarer Position
• Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
• Du bist eine proaktive, pragmatische und selbständige Persönlichkeit und trittst verbindlich sowie lösungsorientiert auf
• Hohe Flexibilität und Bereitschaft, an verschiedenen Standorten präsent zu sein
• Fahrausweis erforderlich, da du im Wechsel vor Ort arbeitest Was wir Dir bieten Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und Mitgestaltung – du bringst deine Ideen ein und prägst die HR‑Arbeit aktiv mit
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien

Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, and the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG St. Gallen is the official sales and service partner of the brands Jaguar, Land Rover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru, and Zeekr and also has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse. Your responsibilities
• Successful sales of new and used vehicles of the House of Brands Range Rover, Defender, and Discovery
• Customer-oriented consultation and care of existing and new customers
• Creation of offers, exchange, and leasing
• Active acquisition of new customers
• Consultation on suitable financing and insurance solutions
• Participation in sales events and exhibitions Your profile
• At least 2-3 years of experience in sales
• Passion for the automotive industry
• Strong customer and service orientation, negotiation skills, and sales flair
• Winner mindset with focus on goal achievement
• Secure written and spoken English, French knowledge is an advantage
• Possession of a Category B driving license The things we offer You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used vehicles, service work, spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Daniela Bühler, Regional Personnel Manager, looks forward to the complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the language forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Das Autohaus Zürich-Altstetten – mit seinem Standort am Hauptsitz der Emil Frey Gruppe – präsentiert die Modellpaletten von sechs Weltmarken sowie eine grosse Auswahl an Occasionen. Zum Betrieb gehören weiter die Markenwerkstätten, eine Carrosserieabteilung sowie ein Ersatzteillager. Unser kleines Team der Fahrzeugdisposition sucht per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Teamleiter/-in Fahrzeugdisposition. Ihre Aufgaben

• Organisation, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Dispositionsprozesse in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen und externen Partnern
• Selbstständige Abwicklung der gesamten Neuwagendisposition (Bestellung, Terminüberwachung, Koordination bis zur Auslieferung)
• Abstimmung und Kommunikation mit Importeuren, Lieferanten und Transportdienstleistern
• Kontrolle von Kauf- und Leasingverträgen sowie Fakturierung von Kunden- und Händlerfahrzeugen
• Pflege und Bewirtschaftung von Fahrzeug- und Kundendaten in den relevanten Systemen inkl. Aufschaltung im Verkaufsportal
• Sicherstellung der Fahrzeugdokumente, Mitarbeit bei Inventuren sowie Unterstützung des Leiters Administration (Stellvertretung) Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise in der Automobilbranche Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fahrzeugdisposition
• Erste Führungserfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an einer Führungsfunktion
• Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil
• Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
• Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Organisationstalent

• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Zurich-Altstetten car dealership - with its location at the headquarters of the Emil Frey Group - presents the model ranges of six world brands, as well as a large selection of used cars. The company also includes the brand workshops, a bodywork department, and a spare parts warehouse. Our small team of vehicle disposition is looking for a Team Leader/Vehicle Disposition immediately or by agreement. Your tasks
• Leading the vehicle disposition and ensuring a smooth daily operation
• Organizing, managing, and continuously optimizing the disposition processes in collaboration with internal departments and external partners
• Independently handling the entire new vehicle disposition (ordering, term monitoring, coordination until delivery)
• Coordinating and communicating with importers, suppliers, and transportation services
• Controlling purchase and leasing contracts, as well as invoicing customer and dealer vehicles
• Maintaining and managing vehicle and customer data in relevant systems, including registration in the sales portal
• Ensuring vehicle documents are available, participating in inventories, and supporting the Administration Manager (deputy) Your profile
• Completed commercial education, ideally in the automotive industry
• Several years of experience in vehicle disposition
• First leadership experience or strong interest in a leadership function
• Fluent German in writing and speaking, additional languages an asset
• Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style
• High commitment, sense of responsibility, and organizational talent
• Team-oriented personality with assertiveness What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual development and training opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)
• The help with events/exhibitions and the close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) is assumed Your profile
• Sales and consulting are fun for you
• You are a sales-oriented and strong negotiating personality and have already gained experience in sales and in the automotive industry (advantage)
• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license
• Your positive attitude enables you to easily integrate into a motivated and open team What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Stefan Lanz, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the form of gender male, female, and diverse (m/w/d). Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Che cosa dovresti sapere su di noi. La Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sullo importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. La Emil Frey Mobility AG è un centro di competenza per i servizi di mobilità integrati intorno all'auto. Ciò include le assicurazioni di veicoli, ma anche le nostre proprie società di finanziamento. Potrai godere di:
• Assicurati che le domande di finanziamento per le rimesse siano complete e corrette prima di procedere.
• Con le tue conoscenze di Excel e la nostra applicazione di leasing, mantieni d'occhio tutti i numeri e assicurati che tutto funzioni.
• Ti occupi dei contratti di leasing di adesione e delle estensioni e controlli la loro completezza.
• Sei proattivo e metti in discussione i processi comuni. Che porti con te:
• Hai completato con successo la tua formazione commerciale e hai già accumulato più di un anno di esperienza lavorativa. Ideale sarebbe avere esperienza nel settore del leasing, della finanza del grossomercato o dell'industria automobilistica.
• Hai un forte senso dei numeri e ti senti a tuo agio nei processi finanziari.
• Ti esprimi in tedesco con sicurezza.
• Le conoscenze di francese o italiano sono di vantaggio.
• Con MS Office, nonché con i sistemi CRM e interni, ti muovi con facilità e ti muovi con sicurezza in ambienti di lavoro digitali.
• Sei pronto a mettere in discussione i processi, a pensare digitalmente e a implementare nuove soluzioni. Perché Emil Frey Mobility AG?
• Oltre alla possibilità di contribuire alla creazione del futuro della mobilità e di realizzare sogni di auto, offriamo altri vantaggi:
• Come azienda familiare, diamo importanza alle relazioni a lungo termine e al crescita sostenibile.
• La possibilità di contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo e all'orientamento di Multilease con le tue idee.
• Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro positivo basato sul team e sul rispetto.
• Numerosi vantaggi (auto nuove e usate, servizi di manutenzione e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro).
• Una pensione propria, attraente e indipendente come un'istituzione di previdenza.
• Investiamo nella tua formazione e offriamo molte possibilità di sviluppo. Fai realtà i tuoi sogni di auto con noi? Sei pronto a prendere la responsabilità e a contribuire con noi alla creazione del futuro della mobilità? Allora ci aspettiamo la tua candidatura! Lascia che insieme creiamo il mondo della mobilità di domani. Le identità di genere femminile e altre sono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori.

What you should know about us. The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Mobility AG is a competence center for integrated mobility services around the car. This includes vehicle insurance, but also our own financing companies. You will enjoy:
• Ensure that loan applications for payments are complete and correct before proceeding.
• With your Excel skills and our leasing application, keep an eye on all numbers and ensure that everything works.
• Take care of leasing contracts and extensions and check their completeness.
• Be proactive and question common processes. What you bring with you:
• You have successfully completed your commercial education and have already accumulated more than a year of work experience. Ideally, you have experience in the leasing sector, wholesale finance, or the automotive industry.
• You have a strong sense of numbers and feel comfortable in financial processes.
• You express yourself in German with confidence.
• French or Italian language skills are an advantage.
• With MS Office, as well as CRM and internal systems, you move with ease and navigate safely in digital work environments.
• You are ready to question processes, think digitally, and implement new solutions. Why Emil Frey Mobility AG?
• In addition to the possibility of contributing to the creation of the future of mobility and realizing car dreams, we offer other benefits:
• As a family-owned company, we value long-term relationships and sustainable growth.
• The opportunity to actively contribute to the development and orientation of Multilease with your ideas.
• You can expect a positive work environment based on teamwork and respect.
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more).
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution.
• We invest in your training and offer many opportunities for development. Make your car dreams come true with us? Are you ready to take responsibility and contribute to the creation of the future of mobility with us? Then we look forward to your application! Let's create the world of mobility of tomorrow together. descriptionByLocale.it:
Diventa parte del nostro team HR e contribuisci alla futura crescita di Emil Frey Mobility! La società Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. A Emil Frey Mobility, siamo impegnati in una collaborazione basata sulla fiducia e sul rispetto reciproco. Come HR Generalist/a (100%), giochi un ruolo importante nella gestione efficiente dei processi HR e nell'assistenza del nostro team con la tua competenza. Se apprezzi un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e lavori con una mentalità positiva e proattiva, sei nel posto giusto! Ecco cosa puoi aspettarti:
• Sei il primo punto di contatto per tutte le questioni HR amministrative e supporti il team in tutti i processi.
• Aiuti nella coordinazione e nell'esecuzione delle attività di reclutamento, dalla pubblicazione dell'annuncio fino alla preparazione dell'intervista con i superiori e alla redazione del contratto.
• Porti la tua affinità per i numeri e supporti nella preparazione e nell'elaborazione del rendiconto mensile dei salari.
• Dalla redazione dei certificati di lavoro fino ad altri documenti personali - mantieni sempre il controllo.
• Hai completato con successo un corso di formazione commerciale e hai già esperienza nell'amministrazione HR. Una formazione come HR-Assistente/a è gradita.
• Il tuo tedesco scorre fluido, hai un buon livello di inglese e porti conoscenze di francese, in modo da poter assistere e reclutare anche i nostri dipendenti nella regione romanda.
• Ti senti a tuo agio nel trattare numeri.
• Come personalità aperta, lavori bene in team e con una mentalità positiva contribuisci al nostro successo come team.
• Sei disposto a fare la strada extra e ti senti motivato dalle trasformazioni e con le tue eccellenti abilità di amministrazione e multitasking puoi ballare su diverse occasioni senza perdere il controllo. Perché Emil Frey Mobility AG? Oltre al nostro team eccezionale, alla nostra passione per l'innovazione e alla possibilità di contribuire alla futura crescita di Emil Frey Mobility AG, offriamo altri vantaggi:
• Numerose agevolazioni (auto nuove e usate, lavori di manutenzione e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattia, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro)
• Una propria, attraente cassa di pensione come ente di previdenza indipendente
• Una prospettiva di lungo termine per l'azienda
• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali
• Almeno 25 giorni di ferie Se ti senti coinvolto in questa posizione e vuoi diventare parte del nostro team HR impegnato, ci piacerebbe conoscerti meglio! Lasciaci lavorare insieme alla futura crescita di Emil Frey Mobility. Siamo ansiosi di ricevere la tua candidatura! Come puoi contattarci Michelle Salina, HR-Generalist/a, si aspetta la candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, certificati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link 'Candida ora!'. Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le donne e le altre identità di genere vengono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa anche che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che una società multietnica e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join our HR team and help shape the future of Emil Frey Mobility! The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Our activities focus on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. At Emil Frey Mobility, we rely on a trusting and respectful collaboration. As an HR Generalist (100%), you will play an important role in shaping our HR processes and supporting our team with your expertise. If you appreciate a dynamic work environment and work with a positive and proactive attitude, you're in the right place! Here's what you can expect:
• You are the first point of contact for all administrative HR matters and support the team in all processes.
• You help with the coordination and execution of recruitment activities, from the publication of the announcement to the preparation of the interview with superiors and the drafting of the contract.
• You bring your affinity for numbers and support in preparing and processing the monthly payroll.
• From creating certificates of employment to other personal documents - you always keep track.
• You have successfully completed a commercial training and have already gained experience in HR administration. A training as HR Assistant is desired.
• Your German flows smoothly, you have a good level of English and bring good French skills, so you can also support and recruit our employees in the Romandie region.
• You feel comfortable with numbers.
• As an open personality, you work well in teams and with a positive attitude, you contribute to our success as a team.
• You are willing to go the extra mile, feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track. Why Emil Frey Mobility AG? In addition to our exceptional team, our passion for innovation, and the opportunity to contribute to the future growth of Emil Frey Mobility AG, we offer other benefits:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Our own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term perspective for the company
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation If you feel involved in this position and want to become part of our committed HR team, we would be happy to get to know you better! Let's work together on the future of Emil Frey Mobility. We are looking forward to receiving your application! How you can contact us Michelle Salina, HR Generalist, looks forward to receiving the complete application (e.g., curriculum, certificates of employment, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!'. For reasons of readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a multilingual and integrative culture enables us to tap into our full potential.
• You are willing to go the extra mile and feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, and the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communications service provider for the automotive industry and responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our Digital Media team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Digital Media Manager to be hired immediately or after an agreement. Your responsibilities:
• Responsible for planning, implementing and maintaining content on brand websites (Wholesale & Retail)
• Internal and external consulting for optimal representations and measures in the content management area
• Webmastering for campaigns, landing pages, forms and content
• Coordination with internal teams, agencies and partners
• Creation of landing pages and newsletters for sales actions
• Monitoring and analysis of website performance
• Implementation of SEO measures
• Optimization of the CMS, including acceptance and testing of new content modules
• Contribution to the content strategy and conversion optimization area
• Completed education (e.g. mediamatiker, polygraf, merchant)
• Several years of work experience in a similar role
• Experience in stakeholder management and knowledge in CMS (Hygraph, TYPO3, WordPress, AEM, builder.io)
• Knowledge in HTML, CSS, JavaScript
• SEO knowledge (technical and on-page)
• Basic knowledge in Web Analytics (Google Analytics)
• Experience with Adobe tools (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator)
• Good knowledge of German and English
• Team-oriented and structured work style
• Motivated personality who likes to take the initiative and work autonomously What we offer you
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, maintenance work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term perspective for the company
• Individual opportunities for further education and development
• At least 25 days of holiday How to contact us We are happy to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!" For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Herold Fahrzeugvermietung AG est le concessionnaire Hertz pour le marché suisse. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communications service provider for the automotive industry and responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our social media team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Social Media Manager to be hired immediately or after agreement. Your responsibilities

• Planning, implementation, and management of all social media activities in the following channels: Facebook & Instagram: Organic & Paid Posts, Local Content / Youtube: Uploads / LinkedIn: Organic & Paid Posts, Local Content / TikTok, SnapChat, and Pinterest

• Collaboration and management with partners, agencies, and departments

• Basic knowledge of photo editing and video editing programs is an advantage

• A own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us. The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. yourmile thinks about mobility in a holistic way and wants to make it available to its customers and passengers in a holistic way: For a connected and future-oriented mobility. Do you love numbers, organization, and contact with people? Then you can expect from us a varied and responsible job. Your tasks
• Independent management of accounts receivable and payable
• Maintenance and coordination of contact with the central accounting of the Emil Frey Group
• Execution of payroll accounting for our taxi drivers
• Creation and management of contract and personnel files
• Point of contact for questions about invoices and payroll
• Assistance and accompaniment of our commercial trainees during their training
• Creation of offers and accounting of special and project orders
• Maintenance and updating of master data in the dispatch system
• Active partner management
• Responsibility and first point of contact for mediation customers
• Creation of the deployment plan and statistics
• Bachelor's degree in business administration
• Work experience in the financial and/or personnel sector
• Enjoyment of responsibility, organization, and direct interaction with different groups
• Passion for training and promotion of trainees
• Secure handling of numbers, people, and administrative processes
• IT affinity and very good knowledge of MS Office (experience with fms is an advantage)
• Independent, structured, and reliable work
• A reliable, structured, and friendly personality What we offer you. You will find a new challenge with many interesting tasks in a dynamic environment:
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual opportunities for further education and development
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us. Joëlle Gross, HR specialist, looks forward to your complete application (e.g. resume, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means that people work in teams that, through their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse team and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

jobs.description:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Betriebs AG erbringt Logistikdienstleistungen für Waren und Fahrzeuge und ist somit die Drehscheibe im Warenfluss zwischen unseren Kunden und deren Endverbraucher. Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie nehmen Umlagerungen vor
• Sie übernehmen die Stellvertretung der Abteilungsleiterin

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Logistiker/-in EFZ
• Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position
• Körperliche Fitness
• Sehr gute Verständigung in Deutsch
• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, Flexibilität und Dienstleistungsorientierung Was wir Ihnen bieten Sie finden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie Sie uns kontaktieren können Andrea Lugonjic, Stv. Leiterin Personal freut sich auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa dovete sapere su di noi La Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la prestazione di servizi finanziari. La Emil Frey Betriebs AG fornisce servizi di logistica per merci e veicoli e rappresenta quindi il fulcro del flusso di merci tra i nostri clienti e i loro consumatori finali. Le vostre mansioni
• Commissionate i pezzi di ricambio in base alle ordinazioni ricevute
• Mettete in magazzino i pezzi di ricambio
• Effettuate le ricollocazioni
• Assume la vice direzione della sezione
• Eseguite le attività di gestione del magazzino Il vostro profilo
• Laurea di scuola professionale come logistico/a EFZ
• Esperienza lavorativa in una posizione simile
• Buona forma fisica
• Buona comprensione della lingua italiana
• Alto senso di qualità, flessibilità e orientamento al servizio Cosa vi offriamo Troverete con noi una nuova sfida con compiti interessanti e molto altro:
• Numerose agevolazioni (nuove e usate auto, lavori di manutenzione e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazioni per veicoli e malattie, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro)
• Una propria, attraente cassa di risparmio come ente di previdenza indipendente
• Una prospettiva di lungo termine per l'azienda
• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali
• Almeno 25 giorni di ferie Come contattarci Andrea Lugonjic, vice direttore del personale, si compiacerà della vostra candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link "
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Betriebs AG provides logistics services for goods and vehicles and is therefore the hub in the goods flow between our customers and their end consumers. Your tasks
• You commission the spare parts according to the incoming orders
• You store the spare parts
• You perform relocations
• You take over the deputy function of the department head
• You perform general warehouse management activities Your profile
• Completed vocational training as a logistics EFZ
• Work experience in a similar position
• Physical fitness
• Good understanding of German
• High quality awareness, flexibility, and customer orientation What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, maintenance work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Andrea Lugonjic, Deputy Head of Personnel, looks forward to your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devez savoir sur nous Le groupe Emil Frey n'est pas seulement une entreprise familiale suisse avec 100 ans d'expérience, mais également l'une des principales entreprises du secteur automobile. Qualité, tradition, innovation et orientation client sont les piliers de l'entreprise. Les activités se concentrent sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. La Emil Frey Betriebs AG fournit des services de logistique pour les marchandises et les véhicules et constitue donc le carrefour du flux de marchandises entre nos clients et leurs consommateurs finals. Vos tâches
• Vous commissionnez les pièces de rechange conformément aux commandes reçues
• Vous stockez les pièces de rechange
• Vous effectuez des relocalisations
• Vous assumez la fonction de vice-présidence de la direction
• Vous exécutez des activités de gestion de stock Votre profil
• Diplôme de formation professionnelle en logistique EFZ
• Expérience professionnelle dans une position similaire
• Condition physique
• Bonne compréhension de l'allemand
• Conscience élevée de la qualité, flexibilité et orientation client Ce que nous vous offrons Vous trouverez avec nous une nouvelle épreuve avec des tâches excitantes et bien plus encore :
• De nombreuses avantages (voitures neuves et d'occasion, travaux de maintenance et pièces de rechange, assurances pour véhicules et maladies, cartes de carburant, hôtels et bien plus encore)
• Votre propre, attractive fonds de pension en tant qu'entité de prévoyance indépendante
• Une perspective à long terme pour l'entreprise
• Possibilités de formation et de développement individuels
• Au moins 25 jours de congé Comment contacter Andrea Lugonjic, vice-président du personnel, se réjouit de votre candidature complète (par exemple, curriculum vitae, attestations de travail, etc.) via le lien "Postulez maintenant !". Pour des raisons de lisibilité, nous avons décidé de ne pas utiliser simultanément les formes grammaticales masculin, féminin et divers (m/w/d). Les identités de genre féminines et diverses sont explicitement incluses. La diversité signifie pour nous que les personnes travaillent dans des équipes qui, en raison de leur unicité et de leur diversité, atteignent les meilleurs résultats possibles. Nous sommes convaincus que des effectifs diversifiés et une culture intégrative nous permettent de pleinement exploiter nos potentialités.

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Altendorf is the official sales and service partner of the Mercedes-Benz, Opel, and Suzuki brands and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse. Your tasks

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us. The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the cornerstones of the company. In this way, the focus of the activities is on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Digital AG belongs to the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communication service provider for the automotive industry, as well as responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Customer Service Manager to start immediately or after an agreement. Your tasks
• Professional handling of customer inquiries via telephone, e-mail, and other digital channels
• Taking, qualifying, and documenting of inquiries (e.g. in JIRA)
• Supporting customers in the analysis and resolution of problems related to our technical products and services
• Coordination of responses and tracking until a clean case closure
• Close collaboration with product management, implementation, academy, and development in more complex cases
• Ensuring efficient and transparent communication between customers and internal departments
• Passing on recurring themes and potential improvements to the competent departments (products, projects, academy, etc.) Your profile
• Completed commercial education or comparable qualification
• First work experience in customer service or in a similar function
• Basic understanding of technical products or SaaS solutions; willingness to learn our solutions (INSiDE, Carmarket)
• Team-oriented, flexible work style and high service orientation
• High social competence and pleasure in direct contact with customers, even in challenging situations
• Careful, structured work style and good time management
• Willingness to take responsibility for cases and to bring them actively to a close
• JIRA basic knowledge or experience with similar ticketing systems
• Excellent communication skills, both orally and in writing: good German and French knowledge in word and writing is a must; any other language is an advantage What we offer you. You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• A separate pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us. We are happy to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical form male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse team and an integrative culture enable us to make the most of our potential.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi Il gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è l'importazione di marchi automobilistici, la gestione di officine, la logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Mobility AG è un centro di competenza per servizi di mobilità integrata legati alle automobili. Ciò include l'assicurazione dei veicoli, ma anche le nostre società di finanziamento. Questo è ciò che puoi aspettarti: hai occhio per i dettagli, pensi in modo consapevole del rischio e apprezzi la responsabilità? Allora dai forma al futuro del finanziamento della mobilità insieme a noi! Da noi ti aspetta un posto entusiasmante e di grande impatto: non ti limiti a controllare le richieste, ma ti assicuri che le nostre operazioni di leasing vengano eseguite in modo sicuro, efficiente e orientato al cliente.
• Controllo della completezza, plausibilità e qualità delle richieste di leasing
• Esecuzione di analisi della solvibilità e dei rischi (GWG, KKG) conformi alla legge
• Elaborazione di modifiche contrattuali come trasferimenti e proroghe
• Consulenza telefonica e scritta a rivenditori, partner e clienti finali
• Supporto al personale sul campo nell'attuazione della nostra strategia di vendita Questo è ciò che portate con voi:
• Avete completato la formazione commerciale. Idealmente con esperienza in finanza o mobilità.
• Hai esperienza professionale nella revisione delle domande o nel leasing/prestito.
• Conoscete i requisiti legali come GWG e KKG e siete in grado di valutare la solvibilità.
• Troverai facile gestire documenti contrattuali, CRM digitale e sistemi di finanziamento.
• Lavori in modo strutturato, pensi in modo analitico e mantieni una visione d'insieme anche sotto pressione di tempo.
• Comunicate in modo chiaro e professionale. Elegante in tedesco, molto bravo in francese, l'italiano è un vantaggio.
• Sei orientato al cliente, un giocatore di squadra e sei disposto a sviluppare continuamente le tue capacità professionali. Cosa ti offriamo Oltre all'opportunità di contribuire a plasmare il futuro della mobilità e realizzare i tuoi sogni automobilistici, offriamo altri vantaggi:
• In quanto azienda a conduzione familiare, diamo valore alle relazioni a lungo termine e alla crescita sostenibile.
• L'opportunità di dare forma attivamente con le vostre idee all'espansione e alla direzione della Emil Frey Mobility AG.
• Da noi puoi aspettarti un ambiente di lavoro positivo basato sullo spirito di squadra e sul rispetto.
• Numerosi sconti (auto nuove e usate, lavori di assistenza e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazione veicolo e malattia, carte carburante, hotel e molto altro ancora)
